title: Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal Reveal Son Vihaan's Face in Diwali Post
excerpt: A day after Vihaan turned one, Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal shared the first clear photograph of their son's face in a joint Diwali Instagram post — ending a year of carefully guarded glimpses.
body:
• Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal shared the first clear photograph of their son Vihaan's face in a joint Instagram post on Diwali, Sunday, November 8.
  • The post came a day after Vihaan's first birthday — he was born on November 7, 2025, and the couple announced his name on January 7, 2026.
  • The family wore coordinated festive outfits: Vihaan in a kurta-pyjama with a yellow embroidered jacket, Katrina in yellow, Vicky in ivory.
  • The caption read: "Our brightest Diwali yet… Wishing everyone love, light and happiness" — signed "Vicky, Katrina & Vihaan."

Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal chose Diwali for a reveal their fans have waited a year for. In a joint Instagram post on Sunday, November 8, the couple shared the first clear photograph of their son Vihaan's face, the three of them together in coordinated festive outfits, Vihaan smiling and waving at the camera.

The caption read: "Our brightest Diwali yet… Wishing everyone love, light and happiness," signed "Vicky, Katrina & Vihaan." Vihaan wore a white kurta-pyjama with a yellow embroidered jacket; Katrina wore a bright yellow traditional ensemble, and Vicky an ivory kurta-pyjama with an embroidered waistcoat. Bollywood Hungama reported the family wore custom outfits by designer Anamika Khanna, styled by Priyanka Kapadia.

A first birthday, then a first photograph

The timing was deliberate. Vihaan turned one on Saturday, November 7 — he was born on November 7, 2025 — and the Diwali post landed the next day. The couple announced his name on January 7, 2026, in a joint post showing only a glimpse of his hand, captioned: "Our Ray of Light. Vihaan Kaushal. Prayers are answered…"

https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfeb2AhNz5o/

Since then, as Bollywood Hungama noted, the actors "have largely kept their son away from the public eye since his birth," sharing only limited glimpses and keeping his face out of view. The Diwali photograph is the first clear look they have offered.

Why this reveal was always going to be an event

Bollywood's biggest couples have split into two camps on children's photographs: those who share family life openly, and those who keep their children entirely out of the frame. Katrina and Vicky spent Vihaan's first year firmly in the second camp. Since the name announcement in January, their public glimpses of him stopped at a small hand and a caption — a choice that turned every subsequent family appearance into a guessing game for fans and photographers alike. Choosing Diwali, and the day after his first birthday, to end that wait gave the reveal the shape of a festival gift rather than a press moment, and the response in the comments — from colleagues who have watched the couple guard this boundary for a year — reflected that. The announcement, when it came, was made on the couple's own terms and timing — a single joint post, like the name announcement in January.

Industry friends respond

The comments filled with colleagues' responses. Mrunal Thakur wrote: "Awwwww baby Vihaan soooo cute my heart is melting happy Diwali munchkin." Kareena Kapoor Khan wrote: "Puddinggggg Baba ♥️♥️♥️ God bless." Sonam Kapoor wrote: "Oh my god! Happy Diwali beautiful people." Arjun Kapoor, Rakul Preet Singh and Kiara Advani were also among those who reacted to the post. For a couple who speak about their work constantly and their family rarely, the photograph did the talking — one family portrait, released on the festival of lights, a day after their son's first birthday.
